The patient exhibits diminished emotional expression, characterized by reduced facial expressivity, limited eye contact, monotonous speech, and decreased spontaneous gesturing. At home, her spouse notes social withdrawal, reduced engagement in shared activities, and limited emotional responsiveness.

There is no report of an acute precipitating event temporally linked to her occupation or marital status. No evidence is provided of substance use or medical conditions that would account for the presentation.
